name: Glitch Feudal Forge
backstory: A blade fighter, a forge worker and a protected ledger keeper earn the feudal workshop's facility budget. Commerce precedes premium equipment for the repaired three-machine roster.
strategy_personality: Medieval robot society supports a visually coherent forge-and-commerce stable: mechanical faces, period clothing, plate armour, and practical tools. These are source-inspired role selections, not three newly discovered named characters. Select actual game sprites and equipment for the final chassis briefs, preserving their compact silhouettes in realistic materials. The Tycoon identity comes from forge investment and equipment purchases within the existing strategy engine.
